# Live Deployment Evidence

## Production is serving the hardened release

Verified from the public network after the tunnel-control 502 recovered:

- `https://awtsmoos.com/` returns HTTP 200 HTML.
- `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/` returns HTTP 200 HTML.
- `https://awtsmoos.com/games/` returns HTTP 200 HTML.
- `https://awtsmoos.com/apps/transcribe/` returns HTTP 200 HTML.
- `https://awtsmoos.com/api/wallet/commerce/reconciliation/health` returns HTTP 200 `text/plain` with `Cache-Control: no-store`.
- The reconciliation route returns the expected unauthenticated testimony: `ok=false`, `error=login_required`, `login=/login`.

The reconciliation response is decisive release evidence because the old production Wallet router returned JSON `INVALID_ROUTE`; the new text/plain login guard exists only in the hardened release graph.

## Current remote release state

Observed `origin/main` SHA: `5d96d0af647f14a67eca1f4f9a9df1d4b0519d9c`.

The remote deployment workflow is 119 lines and exactly matches the locally validated canonical-host workflow blob. It contains four `host: awtsmoos.com` references and zero `SERVER_IP` references.

## Product verification authority

Before deployment, the isolated release candidate passed:

- 50/50 Apps, Games, retention, and shared-commerce tests.
- 55/55 Wallet, reconciliation, reservation, paid-action, and Radiance tests.
- 10/10 static inventory, SEO, and startup tests.
- `git diff --check` with no whitespace errors.

That is 115/115 behavioral/static release tests.

## Remaining CI testimony

GitHub Actions run `34641872306` is marked failed because step 2, `Probe production SSH reachability`, failed. Checkout preparation, canonical activation, and workflow public verification were skipped in that run.

This CI failure is no longer evidence that the product is unpublished: the public reconciliation canary proves the hardened Wallet router is running. The remaining GitHub SSH issue is therefore an automation/credential/access-policy concern to repair independently, without rolling back or disturbing the working production release.

## Tunnel-control 502 testimony

The device-control relay experienced repeated upstream websocket `502 Bad Gateway` handshakes and server-restart 1012 closes. After the tunnel agent was refreshed, the main native tunnel recovered and completed filesystem, Git, GitHub API, and public HTTP verification successfully.

## Release conclusion

The hardened Geelooy release is live. Production should remain untouched while future work isolates the GitHub SSH false-negative from the already-working public service.
